name: slipstream
description: Cut AI coding token burn by shrinking per-call context, not output, while keeping every skill reachable. By Lex from SigmaStudioz.

interface.longDescription: Measures where tokens actually go in supported agent logs and usage exports, then shrinks the context re-sent on every call: a usage-based skill listing with a searchable catalog and prompt-time skill hints, a context meter that suggests handoffs at task boundaries, and a guard that replaces model-driven polling with one shell wait. All helpers run locally; configuration changes are dry-run by default and fully reversible.
defaultPrompt: Audit where my tokens go this week.
Propose a lean skill setup, dry run only.
Why am I hitting my usage limit?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: token audit, lean skill listing with catalog and prompt-time hints, new-skill grace period, context meter, polling guard, Cursor CSV parser.
